reason: The sealed FallingBodies2D sentinel exposed a Release countdown rewrite that moved a loop-local call result before its definition.

subsequent_corrections.reason: The sealed FallingBodies2D sentinel exceeded the short COFF relocation count on Windows ARM64.
The sealed physics contact sentinel rejected the candidate runtime, and the correction campaign exposed an unsafe ARM64 reference-cache iteration before resuming qualification.
The physical macOS ARM64 FallingBodies2D Release sentinel exposed an unsafe post-layout aggregate-copy bypass that redirected call arguments to expired source storage.

The sealed physics contact execution witness retained a by-value aggregate copy whose sole use was a direct call; the correction forwards the unchanged source before register allocation and fuses non-power-of-two ARM64 list addresses.

The first forwarding revision left dead-copy removal in both native encoders and changed an earlier regression witness; the correction compacts the shared Machine IR and remaps every branch target before either backend allocates registers.

The sealed contact execution witness still paid a pointer round-trip for every two-slot collection view argument; the ARM64 internal ABI now flattens small aggregates into x0...x7 only when the complete signature fits the register window.

The first flattened-ABI revision precolored the hot parameters in their incoming registers, then cleared those residences with the legacy pointer-ABI conflict guard; the correction retains only exact incoming-to-residence matches and leaves unsafe permutations spilled.

The exact cumulative test run exposed that the direct ARM64 test runner still injected one pointer per source parameter after the internal ABI began flattening small aggregates; the correction expands those leaves like generated call sites and runs language tests from the isolated workspace root.
The blind physics integration workload exposed that branching callees mutating borrowed aggregates were excluded from control-flow inlining, leaving tens of millions of avoidable calls in hot loops.

The structural counterproof for branching reference inlining exposed that address-producing reference operations were admitted while their address value type was still rejected; the correction admits address parameters and temporaries consistently.

The focused physical integration campaign showed that forcing newly admitted branching reference callees to inline increased register pressure and worsened execution to 2.16x Clang; the correction retains small profitable helpers but subjects the new reference forms to the existing effect and pressure cost model.

The blind integration structure profile showed that recognizing more than one ascending checked view reference discarded every checked cursor, so two hot loops recomputed element addresses; the correction colors and emits every independent reference cursor together.

The blind preparation structure profile showed that every scalar leaf of a large read-only aggregate parameter was forced to stack storage before use; the correction keeps safe leaves eligible for ARM64 scalar registers while address-taking and whole-aggregate uses remain pinned.
